Detail: C2972759 is the exact JKSEMI 1N4007(M7)SMA in DO-214AC/SMA. The retained manufacturer PDF (SHA-256 f893d8385c6fee5af85b9053653bd8e93547c335c031cbab9ecb592c0bb5eddd) identifies the exact package and polarity. The project land uses two 2.50 x 1.80 mm end-cap pads at 4.00 mm centers; JLC's EasyEDA land uses a 4.88 mm center span. Both overlap the same package terminal regions; the reported 0.88 mm delta is a solder-fillet/land-extent preference, not a pin-order or reflection mismatch. The project footprint remains the reviewed board authority. D1 is separately rotation-sourced and remains mandatory in the JLC ORDER-PREVIEW HUMAN GATE before any order.

C83846 is the exact Littelfuse SMBJ15A unidirectional TVS in DO-214AA/SMB. The retained Littelfuse v4 sheet (SHA-256 d7df155be4b1f612085401e8c946f065e284d65a0e7de22b9225a7b73946e51b) specifies solder-pad dimensions I at least 2.260 mm, J and L at least 2.160 mm, and gap K at most 2.740 mm. The project land uses 2.50 x 2.30 mm pads with a 1.80 mm gap and therefore satisfies those manufacturer bounds. JLC's 4.72 mm pad-center span differs from the project's 4.30 mm by 0.42 mm, a known land-extent preference on the same two end caps. Pad 1 is independently verified as cathode on VIN_PROTECTED and pad 2 as anode on GND; the order preview must preserve that polarity.
